subject: Evaluation kickoff: success metrics, exit gates & acceptance test sprint
messages:
From: Claire O'Neill <claire@medalign.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation kickoff & alignment - success criteria & timeline

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Tom and I walked the team through it and there’s clear interest on our side to run a formal evaluation. Before we lock dates, can you help capture the simplest mutual action plan (MAP) that will let us:

- Validate performance at expected load (p95 latency, throughput)
- Measure quality for our customer workflows (response accuracy / QA pass rate)
- Confirm operational controls (logging, retention, and SOC2 artefacts)

We’d like the evaluation to be no longer than 4 weeks. High-level asks:

1) A short acceptance test catalog (pass/fail) we can run against sample queries.
2) Clear exit gates and what constitutes an escalation to a paid pilot.
3) Who on your side will own each milestone so we can line up internal stakeholders.

Can you share a draft MAP + acceptance test list by EOD tomorrow? Also, are there any pre-reqs we should prepare (sample data format, IP allowlist, etc.)?

Thanks — Claire

--
Claire O'Neill
Director of Data & AI, MedAlign
claire@medalign.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Claire O'Neill <claire@medalign.com>, Tom Grant <tgrant@medalign.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff & alignment - success criteria & timeline

Claire — thanks, this is great context. Attached is a draft MAP and a compact acceptance-tests.yml that maps tests to pass/fail criteria and responsible owners. Quick summary below (ETA: see attachments for full details).

Draft acceptance highlights:
- Performance gate: p95 latency < 200ms on production-like VM/GPU profile when scaled to 50 concurrent sessions (measured using our load harness).
- Quality gate: automated QA script should score >= 92% on your labeled sample set (sample-queries.csv attached).
- Reliability gate: no more than 2 degraded responses/hour during a 72-hour soak; errors >5% escalate.
- Security gate: proof of SOC2 report availability (or equivalent) + evidence of audit logging configuration.

Exit gates (what moves to a paid pilot):
- All three gates above met for a 72-hour verification window, AND
- Mutual agreement on resource sizing (Dedicated vs Hosted) and a high-level SOW signed / PO issued.

Owners (our side):
- Neha: evaluation program manager, runs acceptance test windows and compiles results
- Ben: commercial/contract lead for SOW & pricing motion
- Lauren: security & compliance liaison for SOC2 / audit evidence

Pre-reqs for you:
- Sample queries (.csv) + small labeled testset for QA (we received an initial sample yesterday, thanks)
- Network allowlist for test endpoints (we’ll provide IPs)
- Point-of-contact for on-call during soak windows (email + cell)

Next steps I propose: we confirm timeline in a 30-min call this week and I’ll update the MAP to v0.2 with timeboxed milestones and DocuSign-ready SOW language.

Attachments: MAP-MedAlign-v0.2.xlsx (MAP with owners & milestone dates), acceptance-tests.yml (test catalog), sample-queries.csv

Best,
Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Tom Grant <tgrant@medalign.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation kickoff & alignment - success criteria & timeline

Thanks Neha — looks good. Two quick clarifications from our side:

1) Timeline: can we start the official 4-week run on July 5 instead of July 1? That gives our infra team two business days to complete the allowlist and baseline data export.
2) Metrics: we want to add a secondary quality metric — human review pass rate on edge-cases >= 88% (we’ll supply a 150-row edge-case set).

Also, Lauren — on SOC2: we typically need a date-range for the most recent report and a contact for compliance. Happy to get you that info if it helps speed the acceptance gate.

Claire / Neha — if July 5 works I’ll confirm internally and drop the edge-case set by the end of the week.

Regards,
Tom
